mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(play_time), 0) FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS totalPlayTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS totalGames, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(start_time)) FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS playDays, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_achievements WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS achievements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM achievements a JOIN user_games ug ON a.game_id = ug.game_id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId}) AS totalAchievements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = '已完成') AS completedGames, (SELECT CASE WHEN t.prev = 0 AND t.curr = 0 THEN 0 WHEN t.prev = 0 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND((t.curr - t.prev) * 100 / t.prev, 1) END FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0) FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS curr, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0) FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY) AND start_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS prev ) t) AS playTimeTrend, (SELECT CASE WHEN t2.total = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(t2.recent * 100 / t2.total, 1) END FROM ( SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)) AS recent ) t2) AS gamesTrend

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(duration) AS minutes FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND start_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT COALESCE(mg.name, '其他') AS name, ROUND(SUM(pg.play_time) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(play_time) FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId}), 2) AS percent, ROUND(SUM(pg.play_time) / 60.0, 1) AS hours FROM ( SELECT game_id, SUM(play_time) AS play_time FROM user_games WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY game_id HAVING SUM(play_time) > 0 ) pg LEFT JOIN ( SELECT gr.game_id, MIN(gg.id) AS genre_id FROM game_genre_relations gr JOIN game_genres gg ON gg.id = gr.genre_id GROUP BY gr.game_id ) mgr ON mgr.game_id = pg.game_id LEFT JOIN game_genres mg ON mg.id = mgr.genre_id GROUP BY mg.name ORDER BY percent DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(duration) AS minutes FROM play_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND YEAR(start_time) = #{year} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
